review_method: Manual visual comparison of generated region sheet, assembled overview, north/south and village/forest comparisons, and six route audit sheets against gold source centerlines.
findings: North/south canopy and rocky river margins now have native detail comparable to V3 forest-side patches. Source framing and water/route context are retained.
Village doorway spurs are more legible and broadly follow the authoritative guide; door-house-003, 007, 012, 016, 024, 031, 041, 055, 066, 072 and 081 show visible connections after correction.
The forest path network was separately repaired after the route audit identified remaining outline differences.
The workshop spur and some other very short narrow connections remain visually faint; natural edges, shadows and some roof outlines are not pixel-exact to vectors.
Two generated candidates introduced unsupported features: S0-0 masonry-like ruins and S1-2 a road/field. Both were excluded and corrected; selected files are specified by manifest.json.
Patch transitions and the locked outer perimeter retain local canopy contrast and native-resolution differences. Central east/west outer strips remain coarse.
No manual quantitative survey of all painted road widths or complete independent roof count was performed. Exact tile margins prove common-composite continuity, not accuracy of every painted feature.
